page.overview:
What is Kecleon Brothers?

The Kecleon Brothers are the shop keepers in the Mystery Dungeon series. One is the regular color and the other is purple and green (it isn't shiny, just a different color). The green brother sells food and ammo and the purple brother sells TMs. They also appear in the anime special Pokémon Mystery Dungeon Red/Blue Rescue team (Team Go-Getters).
